security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, product URLs, and documented MCP configuration paths. Two setup lines remain confirmed because they direct users to run or configure a third-party MCP package with OAuth credentials. The main residual risks are credential handling and sensitive Outlook and CRM data access.

remediation.issue: Third-party MCP package execution with credentials
remediation.suggestion: Pin the @rarefriend-ai/mcp package version, document package provenance, and require explicit user confirmation before setup commands run.

remediation.issue: OAuth secrets stored in local MCP configuration
remediation.suggestion: Recommend secure secret storage where clients support it, and warn users not to commit MCP configuration files containing secrets.

remediation.issue: Sensitive Outlook and CRM data exposure
remediation.suggestion: Document requested Microsoft permissions, minimize returned email content, and ask before saving email-derived notes to CRM records.

remediation.issue: Hidden configuration paths appear in setup documentation
remediation.suggestion: Clarify that these are user-edited client configuration files and that the skill does not scan hidden home directories.

semantic_findings.title: Third-Party MCP Package Runs With OAuth Credentials
semantic_findings.description: The setup flow asks users to run or configure @rarefriend-ai/mcp with Rarefriend OAuth client credentials. This may be expected, but it gives a third-party MCP package access to sensitive integration credentials.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documentation explicitly names the npm package and shows OAuth client ID and secret values passed to the MCP server. The risk is contextual credential exposure, not hidden behavior.

semantic_findings.title: Sensitive Email and CRM Data Access
semantic_findings.description: The skill is designed to search Outlook messages and combine them with CRM contacts and notes. This handles private communications and relationship data, so users need clear consent and least-privilege boundaries.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The workflow descriptions directly list Outlook email search, sender lookup, CRM profiles, notes, and combined summaries. This is core functionality and therefore a high-confidence data sensitivity finding.

content.user_title: Find Outlook Emails with Rarefriend Context
content.value_statement: Important email history is hard to find when it is separated from contact notes. This skill searches Outlook and connects messages with Rarefriend relationship context.
actual_capabilities: Checks whether the Rarefriend MCP server and Microsoft email integration are connected.
Lists recent Microsoft Outlook emails with optional date, limit, and folder filters.
Searches Outlook messages by sender, subject, email address, keyword, or body snippet.
Looks up email senders in Rarefriend contact records and CRM profiles.
Combines email history with Rarefriend notes for relationship summaries.
Starts the Microsoft email connection flow and checks integration sync status.
limitations: Requires a Rarefriend account and configured Rarefriend MCP server.
Requires Microsoft email authorization before inbox search can work.
Search results depend on synced Outlook data and available Rarefriend records.
Does not provide calendar scheduling or Google email search in this skill.

use_cases.title: Prepare before a customer call
use_cases.description: Find recent Outlook threads and review CRM notes before speaking with a contact.

use_cases.title: Track a pending reply
use_cases.description: Search a sender or subject to confirm whether an expected response arrived.

use_cases.title: Rebuild relationship history
use_cases.description: Combine email threads with Rarefriend notes to summarize prior discussions with a person.

prompt_templates.title: Show recent emails
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a quick inbox view.
prompt_templates.prompt: Show my latest Outlook emails and include sender, subject, date, and a short summary for each one.

prompt_templates.title: Search by sender
prompt_templates.scenario: Find messages from one person or domain.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find Outlook emails from Alex Rivera this month, then show the most relevant threads first.

prompt_templates.title: Connect email and contact context
prompt_templates.scenario: Review relationship history for a known contact.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find recent emails from Jordan Lee, look up the Rarefriend contact record, and summarize the email history with CRM notes.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a relationship briefing
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced synthesis before a meeting or follow-up.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Outlook for contract discussions with Acme, cross-reference the senders in Rarefriend, and prepare a concise follow-up briefing.

output_examples.input: Find my recent Outlook emails from Priya about renewal timing.
output_examples.output: Found three matching emails. The latest message asks for updated renewal terms, and Rarefriend notes show a prior budget concern from June.

output_examples.input: What is the history with Morgan from Northstar?
output_examples.output: The email thread discusses onboarding dates, support expectations, and a pending security review. Rarefriend notes mention Morgan prefers concise written follow-ups.

output_examples.input: Connect my Outlook email to Rarefriend.
output_examples.output: The assistant checks integration status and provides a time-limited connection link when Microsoft email is not connected.

best_practices: Confirm the Rarefriend MCP connection before searching Outlook data.
Use focused sender, subject, and date filters to reduce irrelevant email results.
Ask before writing email-derived context into CRM notes.
anti_patterns: Do not search broad inbox history when a specific sender or subject is available.
Do not expose OAuth client secrets in shared prompts, screenshots, or repositories.
Do not summarize private email threads for users who should not access them.

faq.question: What account do I need?
faq.answer: You need a Rarefriend account, Rarefriend MCP credentials, and access to the Microsoft Outlook mailbox you want to search.

faq.question: Does this skill read my whole inbox automatically?
faq.answer: No. It uses Rarefriend MCP tools when you ask for email listing, search, or relationship context.

faq.question: Can it connect Outlook for me?
faq.answer: It can start the Microsoft email connection flow and return a connection link when the integration is not active.

faq.question: Can it search by email address?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented search workflow supports sender name, sender email, subject, keyword, and body snippet matches.

faq.question: Does it update CRM notes?
faq.answer: The workflow can create Rarefriend notes, but users should approve any note content before it is saved.

faq.question: Can I use it in Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents setup for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Claude Desktop, and compatible Agent Skills clients.
